# OBSBOT triggers

## AI tracking locked/unlocked

Runs when AI tracking locks onto a subject or lets go of it.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **State** | Choose Locked to react only when it locks on, Unlocked only when it lets go, or Any for both. Options: Any, Locked, Unlocked. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsbot.aiLocked%` | True when AI tracking is locked on a subject |
| `%obsbot.deviceName%` | The selected camera's name |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.aiTrackingChanged`</small>

## Camera slept or woke

Runs when the camera goes to sleep or wakes up.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **State** | Choose Awake to react only when the camera wakes up, Asleep only when it goes to sleep, or Any for both. Options: Any, Awake, Asleep. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsbot.awake%` | True when the camera is awake |
| `%obsbot.deviceName%` | The selected camera's name |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.sleepStateChanged`</small>

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot starts talking to OBSBOT Center (the OBSBOT camera app) or to your OBSBOT camera.

<small>Type id: `obsbot.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot loses contact with OBSBOT Center or the camera.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%reason%` | A short text saying why contact was lost |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.disconnected`</small>

## Gimbal moved

Runs when the camera turns or tilts to a new position.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsbot.pitch%` | How far the camera is tilted up or down, in degrees |
| `%obsbot.yaw%` | How far the camera is turned left or right, in degrees |
| `%obsbot.deviceName%` | The selected camera's name |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.gimbalMoved`</small>

## Other OBSBOT message (advanced)

For experts: runs when OBSBOT sends a message that Cuebot does not turn into one of the other triggers. Useful for commands this app has no trigger for.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Addresses** | Only react to this message address, like "/OBSBOT/WebCam/General/SetZoom". Separate several with commas. Leave empty to react to every such message. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsbot.address%` | The message's address |
| `%obsbot.arg0%` | The first value in the message |
| `%obsbot.arg1%` | The second value |
| `%obsbot.arg2%` | The third value |
| `%obsbot.args%` | All the values as one list |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.message`</small>

## Selected camera changed

Runs when a different camera gets selected in OBSBOT Center. Only matters if you have more than one OBSBOT camera.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsbot.deviceIndex%` | Which camera is selected, counting from 0 (0 is the first camera) |
| `%obsbot.deviceName%` | The selected camera's name |
| `%obsbot.deviceCount%` | How many cameras are connected |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.deviceChanged`</small>

## Zoom changed

Runs when the camera's zoom or field of view changes, whether from Cuebot, OBSBOT Center or the camera itself.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%obsbot.zoom%` | The zoom, 0 to 100 percent |
| `%obsbot.oldZoom%` | The zoom before the change |
| `%obsbot.fovDegrees%` | The field of view, like "86°" |
| `%obsbot.deviceName%` | The selected camera's name |

<small>Type id: `obsbot.zoomChanged`</small>
